Learn tricks to optimize your Windows Vista experience


Dramatically improve the performance of your Vista PC with a few simple tweaks




Whether you upgraded to Vista, installed it fresh, or purchased Vista on your new PC, your operating system is not as well tuned as it could be. Join the discussion in the Speed Up Windows Vista online course and learn more than a dozen things you can do to turbocharge Vista, from configuration changes that conserve power, to tricks for streamlining the inner workings of your computer.
    

Explore the lessons to learn:
    

 
        Cleaning out unwanted files from your hard drive
 
        Adjusting your graphics settings
 
        Disabling unnecessary programs
 
        Streamlining your computer's registry


Join the discussion now!
